missing_prerequisite.required_before_unblocking_r04: Coordinator records one concrete NEW byte-level supplier/writer anchor beyond W3 F1: either a definition supplying G=0x4223CA04 or a write to P+0 with dataflow establishing that its base is the P used by the selected reader.
required_evidence: Exact source path, size and SHA-256; conditional mapping/base; bounded VA interval and bytes with fresh static decode.
Explicit operation width, source, destination and guard; why the anchor adds information beyond existing P reads and the N+0x14 copy.
One bounded immediate chain to inspect; separate its local proof from lifetime, ordering and cross-call identity assumptions.
insufficient: Another load of G or P+0/P+0x14.
Same global address, same offset, manager slot or stride.
Zero initialization/reset of N+0x14, or a literal-search miss.
R03 writer to the different cell 0x4252194C.
missing_prerequisite.tolerance_frontier: Supplier/lifetime of the pointer observed at each actor call and writer/contents of pointee+0x14 are separately unknown. A P+0 writer would not establish tolerance; a +0x14 writer needs its own base-identity and guard proof.

conditional: Existing W3 local dataflow assumes normal calls preserving nonvolatile registers/stack and no hidden corruption of the record/output pointer. Opaque/TLS/virtual/overlapping paths and complete reachability remain open.
EDI_N(t_write)==EBP_N(t_read) requires equal observed manager and reader index at both calls. The same static slot 0x424F46C0 and stride 0x74 establish only a family/layout.

P_write, P_age and each P_tolerance observation are independent unless pointer equality, lifetime and noninterference are separately established. Equal addresses alone do not establish equal pointee contents.
W3 unordered-branch interpretation is quiet-NaN/nontrapping only. Original MXCSR/FTZ/DAZ, signaling NaNs, faults and FP flags are not established.
